description: This Java source file defines the 'GlobalErrorRegistry' class, which manages strategies for deserializing subclasses of 'DittoRuntimeException' from JSON objects and headers. It maintains mappings for different JSON exception types and provides mechanisms to resolve error types and parse exceptions from JSON representations.

classes.name: GlobalErrorRegistry
classes.description: Singleton class that manages serialization and deserialization strategies for 'DittoRuntimeException' subclasses, providing an instance and resolving error types from JSON objects.

classes.name: GlobalErrorRegistry.DittoJsonExceptionRegistry
classes.description: Inner class that maintains a mapping to deserialize specific JSON exception types into 'DittoJsonException' instances.

classes.name: GlobalErrorRegistry.ExceptionParsingStrategyFactory
classes.description: Inner class that provides factory methods for creating deserialization strategies for 'DittoRuntimeException' instances based on JSON annotations.

methods.name: resolveType
methods.description: Resolves the error type identifier from a JSON object, throwing an exception if the error code is missing.
